description: CFS-NHERI: Seismic Resiliency of Repetitively Framed Mid-Rise Cold-Formed Steel Buildings is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Tara Hutchinson, University of California San Diego (ucsd.edu). The need for low cost, multi-hazard resilient buildings constructed of sustainable, low-carbon footprint materials is urgent. Mid-rise buildings framed from thin-walled, cold-formed steel (CFS) have the ability to support this urgent need. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Cold-Formed Steel, In-line Wall Testing, Finishes, Gravity Walls, Tall building Systems, Fastener Testing. Published 2023-02-21. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
